Priya Rao: Samir at Nimbus reported devs couldn't get tokens after last night's cert rotation. Theyre worried because renewal is next week.
Omar Velasquez: Scope? Production traffic OK?
Priya Rao: Production fine; ~6 dev seats saw 401s in control-plane. Attached screenshot.
Neha Singh: Root cause: new intermediate cert not accepted by some older client stacks (TLS handshake mismatch). We have a rollback ready.
incident-bot: Incident OP-2026-29 created (cert-rotation).
Omar Velasquez: Draft comm: acknowledge, non-sensitive cause (compatibility), mitigation, offer 2 wks premium support + $500 credit. Keep concise.
Priya Rao: Sending this to Samir now: "Hi Samir — thanks for flagging. We identified a certificate chain compatibility issue after a rotation that caused some developer token requests to fail. Weve reintroduced the previous intermediate cert to restore compatibility and are monitoring. If you still see auth failures, reply here or contact cs+oncall@redwood.com. Weve applied a $500 credit and scheduled a private troubleshooting session. Full RCA in 48h."
Neha Singh: Rolling back in 5m. Command: ./infra/certs/rollback_intermediate --env=private-nimbus --preserve-root=true
incident-bot: Rollback started (rb-2026-78).
Neha Singh: Rollback complete. Token failures returned to baseline within ~2 minutes. Monitoring for 20m.
Priya Rao: Logged credit in renewal tracker and pinged renewals@. RCA due in 48h; follow-up survey at 72h.
Samir (Nimbus): Thanksappreciate the quick response — will confirm with my team.
Omar Velasquez: Postmortem action: add intermediate-cert compatibility test to private-deploy suite and pre-rotation verification in runbook. Assign eng-infra for next sprint.
Priya Rao: Closing loop: initial comm +10m, rollback +25m, green +27m, credit applied immediately. Will attach RCA draft before customer follow-up. :white_check_mark:
